description: §19.16.2 (S430 round 5) — a `defer` directly in an arm of a value-form `match` (`let k = match m { .A :> { defer D(); let t = 7; t } … }`) is E-DEFER-UNSUPPORTED-SITE (exactly once): lowered, the defer block would capture the arm's result and k would be left unset — measured before this check.
rationale: §19.16.2: an arm of a match / if / for used for its value is not a stage-1 defer site; it SHALL be a compile error rather than silently lose the produced value.
